limitations: The full enhancement goal remains active and incomplete; these are experimental candidates.

Mac gameplay acceptance is bounded to existing Route29 progress, menu persistence/cancellation, Off walking, and visible intervals. Full Surf/cave/special-area and active legendary gameplay remain pending.

Original native rate and legendary instruction tests use bounded dependency/RNG fixtures, not a complete emulator legendary encounter. The ordinary Off option preserves that separate native legendary path by design.

These current-ROM emulator runs contain no RAM fixtures and import existing project-created native saves, including HG-derived test progress for SS. They do not establish a fresh SS story or general save interchangeability.

Spawn intervals count free field-input updates, not display frames. Menus/scripts pause them; density is still controlled separately. No exact multiplier of final battles after all native caps/Repel/ability/legendary gates is claimed.

Rate changes do not implement cave/water visible models, legendary sprites, shiny effects, or other pending inventory features. The optional Roaming only grass setting still suppresses every hidden grass-step battle, including native roaming legendaries.
No hardware or complete-release claim is made.
